# skillprobe

> Eval harness for agent skills (SKILL.md): measures whether the right skill loads when many compete, and whether the model follows it once loaded - repeated trials, 95% confidence intervals, routing collisions and a CI gate, on any OpenAI-compatible API.

Key facts:

- Python 3.10+ CLI: `skillprobe run probe.yaml`. A skill is a folder with SKILL.md: YAML frontmatter (`name`, `description`) and a Markdown body.
- Mirrors how agent harnesses expose skills: the model sees only names and descriptions and loads a body through a `load_skill` tool call; `routing_only: true` stops each trial after the first turn.
- Deterministic checks, no judge model: `triggered`, `loads`, `not_loads`, `contains`, `not_contains`, `regex`, `json_schema`, `max_chars`.
- Metrics: trigger precision and recall, pass rate with 95% Wilson intervals, flaky cases, per-skill routing table and collisions table, cost and latency per model.
- Flags: `--baseline` (no skills offered), `--repeats`, `--models`, `--cases`, `--cache-only` (rebuild reports from cached responses), `--fail-under` (CI gate); `max_cost_usd` budget cap.
- Providers built in: openrouter, openai, deepseek, dashscope (Qwen), zai (GLM), moonshot (Kimi), yandex (YandexGPT); any other OpenAI-compatible API in two lines.
- Bundled results: a commit-message skill on five models (OpenAI, Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi), and routing golden sets on 28 public skills - 14 from anthropics/skills, 14 from obra/superpowers, 46 labeled cases.
- Install: `pipx install skilldx` (PyPI name; `skillprobe` on PyPI is an unrelated project), command `skillprobe`. GitHub Action: `uses: AndreySukhanov/skillprobe@v0.3.0` with `probe`, `fail-under`, `args`; the report goes to the job summary. Docker: `ghcr.io/andreysukhanov/skillprobe`.
- The response cache of both routing probes is in the repo: `--cache-only` rebuilds their reports with no API key.
- Version 0.3.0; 35 offline tests; Source-Available license; third-party skills keep their own licenses.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/AndreySukhanov/skillprobe/blob/main/README.md): the problem, results, routing across 28 public skills, quick start, writing a probe, FAQ
- [Example probe](https://github.com/AndreySukhanov/skillprobe/blob/main/examples/commit-message/probe.yaml): skills, target, models, repeats, budget
- [Example cases](https://github.com/AndreySukhanov/skillprobe/blob/main/examples/commit-message/cases.yaml): positives and near-misses with checks
- [Example report](https://github.com/AndreySukhanov/skillprobe/blob/main/examples/commit-message/results/report.md): summary per model, failures with output
- [Labeling rules](https://github.com/AndreySukhanov/skillprobe/blob/main/examples/public-skills/LABELS.md): how the routing golden sets are labeled
